sentences.text: Hong Kong , officially the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People 's Republic of China , is an autonomous territory on the Pearl River Delta of China .	autonomous territory	autonomous territory	Pearl River Delta	Pearl River Delta	China	China
Macau lies across the delta to the west , and the province of Guangdong borders the territory to the north .	Macau	Macau	Guangdong	Guangdong

With a total land area of 1,106 km2 and a population of over 7.3 million of various nationalities , it ranks as the world 's fourth most densely populated sovereign state or territory .	nationalities	Nationality	densely populated sovereign state or territory	List of sovereign states and dependent territories by population density

After the First Opium War -LRB- 1839 -- 42 -RRB- , Hong Kong became a British colony with the perpetual cession of Hong Kong Island , followed by the Kowloon Peninsula in 1860 and a 99-year lease of the New Territories from 1898 .	Hong Kong Island	Hong Kong Island	First Opium War	First Opium War	British colony	British Hong Kong	Kowloon Peninsula	Kowloon Peninsula	New Territories	New Territories
Hong Kong was later occupied by Japan during World War II until British control resumed in 1945 .	occupied by Japan	Japanese occupation of Hong Kong	World War II	World War II

In the early 1980s , negotiations between the United Kingdom and China resulted in the 1984 Sino-British Joint Declaration , which paved way for the transfer of sovereignty of Hong Kong in 1997 , when it became a special administrative region -LRB- SAR -RRB- of the Peoples Republic of China with a high degree of autonomy .	United Kingdom	United Kingdom	China	China	Sino-British Joint Declaration	Sino-British Joint Declaration	transfer of sovereignty of Hong Kong	transfer of sovereignty of Hong Kong	special administrative region	Special administrative regions of China
Under the principle of `` one country , two systems '' , Hong Kong maintains a separate political and economic system from China .	China	China
Except in military defence and foreign affairs , Hong Kong maintains its independent executive , legislative and judiciary powers .
In addition , Hong Kong develops relations directly with foreign states and international organisations in a broad range of `` appropriate fields '' .

Hong Kong is one of the world 's most significant financial centres , with the highest Financial Development Index score and consistently ranks as the world 's most competitive and freest economic entity .	financial centres	Financial centre#Ranking	Financial Development Index	Financial Development Index

As the world 's 8th largest trading entity , its legal tender , the Hong Kong dollar , is the world 's 13th most traded currency .	Hong Kong dollar	Hong Kong dollar	13th most traded currency	Foreign exchange market#Trading characteristics

It 's also a member of the World Trade Organization -LRB- WTO -RRB- and the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation -LRB- APEC -RRB- .	World Trade Organization	World Trade Organization	Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation	Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation

Hong Kong 's tertiary sector dominated economy is characterised by simple taxation with a competitive level of corporate tax and supported by its independent judiciary system .	tertiary sector	tertiary sector	simple taxation	Taxation in Hong Kong

However , while Hong Kong has one of the highest per capita incomes in the world , it suffers from severe income inequality .	per capita incomes	List of countries by GDP (PPP) per capita	income inequality	List of countries by income equality

Hong Kong is renowned for its deep natural harbour , which enables ready access by international cargo ships , and its impressive skyline , with a very high density of skyscrapers ; the territory boasts the second largest number of high rises of any city in the world .	skyline	List of tallest buildings in Hong Kong	high rises	List of cities with the most high-rise buildings
It has a very high Human Development Index ranking and the world 's longest life expectancy .	longest life expectancy	List of countries by life expectancy#List by the United Nations, for 2010–2015
Over 90 % of the population makes use of well-developed public transportation .	public transportation	Transport in Hong Kong

Seasonal air pollution with origins from neighbouring industrial areas of Mainland China , which adopts loose emissions standards , has resulted in a high level of atmospheric particulates .
